scope: Installed notification stacks; canonical Discord label; menu material and shader with notification gradients disabled; subtle About-style black/white card rims; compact exterior title shadow; foreground contrast from actual compositor backdrop without shadows inside cards.
environment: Disposable pinned KDE neon Wayland VM, Plasma 6.8.1 / Qt 6.11.1, 3840x2160 at 2x; isolated Arch KWin X11 6.6.5; Fedora SDK 6.7.5.
coverage_limits: Focused native notification qualification, not a fresh full desktop/installer gallery.
The complete remote distro matrix remains enabled and asynchronous.
The unchanged appearance controller retains its prior full Qt/Kvantum/GTK application-continuity evidence; this run adds actual notification boundary crossing in each edition.
Foreground uses an 8x8 sample of the blurred backdrop per notification window, not a per-glyph sampler.
Software scenegraphs use an exterior raised text shadow; compositor-adaptive foreground requires Acrylic Glass.
